text.p: FT. WORTH, Texas, Jan 15 - Tandy Corp board member Jesse Upchurch said on Wednesday he resigned from the company's board because of an ongoing impasse with the board over the performance of Tandy's chief executive officer.
Upchurch said he announced his resignation after the nominating committee decided not to renominate him.
"As the longest serving director on the board and the largest personal shareholder in Tandy stock, I believe my job is to protect and enhance shareholder value," Upchurch said.
"I feel I can no longer be effective in that regard as a board member," he said.

In a separate statement, Tandy said its board had an annual review process which did not indicate any impasse among members about Roach's performance. The company said it appreciated Upchurch's service to Tandy.
